articles.summary: WATSONVILLE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Granite (NYSE:GVA) announced today it has been awarded a Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) contract by the Tucson Airport Authority (TAA) for the CMAR2 project at Tucson International Airport in Tucson, Arizona. The project is valued at approximately $52 million and was included in Granite’s third quarter 2026 CAP.
articles.title: Granite Selected for $52 Million CMAR Contract on the Airfield Safety Enhancement (ASE) Program at the Tucson International Airport
